items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: we had another orchestra by the name of Holman's. Holman. Orchestra, yes. And I played with him 18 years and after that I organized my own

ctx.x: stuff you used the same brass band lineup? That same brass band lineup. 14 pieces inside of

14, that's right. Of course in the latter days I organized my own orchestra and we had another orchestra by the name of Holman's. Holman. Orchestra, yes. And I played with him 18 years and after that I organized my own as known as Hoops Dreamland Serenators. How many were in that about? Well we had an average around eight to nine. Eight to nine. Did you use the bass or piano or guitar or anything in those? Well yeah we had the guitar, we had the bass, the piano, trumpet, three saxophones and drums. And for years…
I wondered when the full band played they used two drummers inside. That's right, two drummers. One fellow hitting the bass drum. You used the bass drum for dancing too?
